main_text.l: Vt 76 & 20, maximus communis diuisor est 4, sic:
Datis tribus, si duorum antecedentium maximus
communis diuisor cum tertio comparatus, eundem
quoq; diuiserit: idem primò inuentus, omnium e-
rit maximus communis diuisor, atque ita deinceps
Hic enim 7, maximus communis diuisor duorum an-
dem quoq; diuidit, similiterq; quartum 63, quare omnium
communis diuisor sequentes non diuidit, tum inuento

page.notes: Marginal text on the left of the page is cut off by the binding and the facing page; the arithmetic display is reconstructed from the layout and some digits are uncertain. Show-through from the reverse side ignored. Left-edge fragment not transcribed.
